items.html: And then these mochin, called the soul of ZA, were in the aspect of Mayin Nukvin to Bina; and Aba and Ima coupled, and corrected Malchut without the agency of ZA. And the matter is that Leah was already corrected back to back before Rachel, for first the illuminations of Leah come out, and afterward the illuminations of Rachel. And the two of them are still separate, even though both of them receive their illumination through ZA.
